arxiv-2103-01891.title: Simulating deformable objects for computer animation: a numerical perspective Thanks: The first and last authors are supported by NSERC Discovery grants 84306 and RGPIN/2017-04604 respectively. Pai’s research was also supported by a Canada Research Chair and an NSERC Idea-to-Innovation grant co-spon
arxiv-2103-01891.description: Abstract . We examine a variety of numerical methods that arise when considering dynamical systems in the context of physics-based simulations of deformable objects. Such problems arise in various applications, including animation, robotics, control and fabrication. The goals and merits of suitable numerical algorithms for these applications are different from those of typical numerical analysis research in dynamical systems.

arxiv-2301-03462.title: Unleashing the Power of Shared Label Structures for Human Activity Recognition Conference: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management; October 21–25, 2023; Birmingham, United Kingdom Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Information
arxiv-2301-03462.creator: Xiyuan Zhang, Ranak Roy Chowdhury, Jiayun Zhang, Dezhi Hong, Rajesh K. Gupta, Jingbo Shang
arxiv-2301-03462.description: Abstract . Current human activity recognition (HAR) techniques regard activity labels as integer class IDs without explicitly modeling the semantics of class labels. We observe that different activity names often have shared structures. For example, “open door” and “open fridge” both have “open” as the action; “kicking soccer ball” and “playing tennis ball” both have “ball” as the object.

arxiv-2311-09210.title: Accepted to EMNLP 2024 Chain-of-Note: Enhancing Robustness in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
arxiv-2311-09210.creator: Wenhao Yu, Hongming Zhang, Xiaoman Pan, Peixin Cao
arxiv-2311-09210.description: Abstract Retrieval-augmented language model (RALM) represents a significant advancement in mitigating factual hallucination by leveraging external knowledge sources. However, the reliability of the retrieved information is not always guaranteed, and the retrieval of irrelevant data can mislead the response generation. Moreover, standard RALMs frequently neglect their intrinsic knowledge due to the interference from retrieved information.

arxiv-2402-11991.title: Measuring the magnetic dipole moment and magnetospheric fluctuations of SXP 18.3 with a Kalman filter
arxiv-2402-11991.creator: Joseph O’Leary, Andrew Melatos, Nicholas J. O’Neill, Patrick M. Meyers, Dimitris M. Christodoulou, Sayantan Bhattacharya, Silas G.T. Laycock
arxiv-2402-11991.description: Abstract The magnetic dipole moment μ \mu of an accretion-powered pulsar in magnetocentrifugal equilibrium cannot be inferred uniquely from time-averaged pulse period and aperiodic X-ray flux data, because the radiative efficiency η 0 \eta_{0} of the accretion is unknown, as are the mass, radius, and distance of the star.

arxiv-2405-17723.title: TableDC: Deep Clustering for Tabular Data
arxiv-2405-17723.creator: Hafiz Tayyab Rauf, Andre Freitas, Norman W. Paton
arxiv-2405-17723.description: Abstract . Deep clustering (DC), a fusion of deep representation learning and clustering, has recently demonstrated positive results in data science, particularly text processing and computer vision. However, joint optimization of feature learning and data distribution in the multi-dimensional space is domain-specific, so existing DC methods struggle to generalize to other application domains (such as data integration and cleaning).

arxiv-2502-02576.title: Neutrino-induced charged-current coherent pion production for constraining the muon neutrino flux at DUNE
arxiv-2502-02576.creator: Mun Jung Jung, Vishvas Pandey, Gray Putnam, David W. Schmitz
arxiv-2502-02576.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mun Jung Jung, Vishvas Pandey, Gray Putnam, David W. Schmitz. We study neutrino induced charge current coherent pion production ( ν μ ​ CC-Coh ​ π \nu_{\mu}\text{CC-Coh}\pi ) as a tool for constraining the neutrino flux at the Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment (DUNE). The neutrino energy and flavor in the process can be directly reconstructed from the outgoing particles, making it especially useful to specifically constrain the muon neutrino component of the total flux.

arxiv-2601-03579.title: SpatiaLoc: Leveraging Multi-Level Spatial Enhanced Descriptors for Cross-Modal Localization
arxiv-2601-03579.creator: Tianyi Shang, Pengjie Xu, Zhaojun Deng, Zhenyu Li, Zhicong Chen, Lijun Wu
arxiv-2601-03579.description: Abstract Cross-modal localization using text and point clouds enables robots to localize themselves via natural language descriptions, with applications in autonomous navigation and interaction between humans and robots. In this task, objects often recur across text and point clouds, making spatial relationships the most discriminative cues for localization.

arxiv-2601-05991.title: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instruction Ambiguity Detection
arxiv-2601-05991.creator: Jiayu Ding, Haoran Tang, Ge Li
arxiv-2601-05991.description: Abstract In safety-critical domains, linguistic ambiguity can have severe consequences; a vague command like “Pass me the vial” in a surgical setting could lead to catastrophic errors. Yet, most embodied AI research overlooks this, assuming instructions are clear and focusing on execution rather than confirmation.

pmc-10581018.title: Emergence of ST1193 Clone in Maternal and Neonatal ESBL-Producing E. coli Isolates
pmc-10581018.creator: Ling Wei, Qiyan Chen, Lu Yang, Tongzhen Ji, Wenjing Peng, Bing Shao, Hui Li
pmc-10581018.description: ObjectiveThe emerging epidemic of extended-spectrum β-lactamase-producing E. coli (ESBL-EC) is a global public health crisis. ESBL-EC infections are increasing worldwide and contribute to morbidity and mortality among newborn infants. However, the antimicrobial resistance characteristics and clonal transmission of maternal and neonatal ESBL-EC isolates need to be further deciphered.

pmc-10643242.title: Regional Disparities in the Infant Mortality Rate in Korea Between 2001 and 2021
pmc-10643242.creator: Hyeongtaek Woo, Ji Sook Kim
pmc-10643242.description: BackgroundThe infant mortality rate (IMR) has been considered an important indicator of the overall public health level. Despite improvements in recent decades, regional inequalities in the IMR have been reported worldwide. However, there are no Korean epidemiological studies on regional disparities in the IMR.

pmc-11539096.title: Enamel matrix derivative monotherapy versus combination therapy with bone grafts for periodontal intrabony defects: An updated review
pmc-11539096.creator: Akira Hasuike, Taito Watanabe, Akemu Hirooka, Shingi Arai, Hideyasu Akutagawa, Naoto Yoshinuma, Shuichi Sato
pmc-11539096.description: This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness of combining enamel matrix derivative (EMD) with various bone grafts in periodontal regenerative surgery, specifically targeting intrabony defects. Randomized controlled trials with 12-month follow-ups were included. Clinical outcomes assessed included clinical attachment level, probing depth, gingival recession, and radiographic defect fill.

pmc-11541846.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has resulted in a significant toll of deaths worldwide, exceeding seven million individuals, prompting intensive research efforts aimed at elucidating the molecular mechanisms underlying the pathogenesis of SARS-CoV-2 infection. Despite the rapid development of effective vaccines and therapeutic interventions, COVID-19 remains a threat to humans due to the emergence of novel variants and largely unknown long-term consequences.

pmc-11658386.title: Associations between (pharmaco-)genetic markers and postoperative pain after inguinal hernia repair – a prospective study protocol
pmc-11658386.creator: Florine M. Wiss, Ulrich Dietz, Andreas Thalheimer, Sebastian Lamm, Robert Rosenberg, Samuel S. Allemann, Henriette E. Meyer zu Schwabedissen, Anna Bollinger, Markus L. Lampert
pmc-11658386.description: BackgroundPostoperative pain is a common complication following surgery, with severity and duration varying between patients. Chronic postoperative pain after inguinal hernia surgery has an incidence rate of approximately 10%. Risk factors for acute and chronic pain following hernia surgery include age, sex, psychosocial factors, and demographic background.

pmc-12565454.title: HTS and PCR Methods Are the Most Used in the Diagnosis of Aspergillosis: Advantages over Other Molecular Methods
pmc-12565454.creator: Carlos Alberto Castro-Fuentes, Esperanza Duarte-Escalante, María Guadalupe Frías-De-León, María del Carmen Auxilio González-Villaseñor, María del Rocío Reyes-Montes
pmc-12565454.description: Aspergillosis includes a variety of diseases caused by species of the genus Aspergillus, ranging from non-invasive allergic diseases to chronic, invasive pulmonary infections, which are potentially fatal in immunocompromised hosts. Therefore, there is an urgent need for new diagnostic tools and the optimization of existing tests to improve patient care.

pmc-12727173.title: Antinociceptive and anti-inflammatory effects of a formulation based on Alpinia zerumbet essential oil: an in vivo and in vitro approach
pmc-12727173.creator: Wagner Hummig, Julia Maria Zortea, Victor Augusto Benedicto dos Santos, Luiz Eduardo Nunes Ferreira, Juliana Geremias Chichorro
pmc-12727173.description: Background: Current pharmacological treatments for acute orofacial pain present limitations, risks, and side effects. Thus, the search for safer alternatives is justified. The essential oil of Alpinia zerumbet (EOAz) has been used in the treatment of several medical conditions, including pain and inflammation, but scientific validation is scarce.

pmc-12827446.title: Neutron activation analysis of manganese in samples of human sternum
pmc-12827446.creator: Song Yue, Elizabeth Helen Jaye, Gill Nelson, Brad A. Racette, Linda H. Nie
pmc-12827446.description: A compact neutron activation analysis (NAA) system utilizing a deuterium-deuterium (DD) neutron generator was developed to detect manganese (Mn) in bone in vivo. Mn was selected for study due to the elevated risk of overexposure among certain occupational groups and segments of the general population, which can result in irreversible neurotoxic effects.

This project aimed to establish consensus among HS experts to define HS Competence Centers (HSCC) criteria using the Delphi consensus method.
